content.value_statement: Fullscreen UI work can be fragile across browsers and Angular components. This skill provides screenfull patterns for toggles, viewers, dashboards, and presentation modes.
actual_capabilities: Shows Angular examples for document and element fullscreen toggles.
Demonstrates fullscreen gallery and presentation mode patterns.
Explains common screenfull methods, events, and state checks.
Lists integration steps for browser support and event cleanup.
Calls out user interaction, exit controls, and mobile limitations.
limitations: It is a documentation skill and does not modify project files by itself.
Examples are focused on Angular and the ng-events project style.
Fullscreen behavior still depends on browser and device support.
The screenfull dependency must exist before the examples can run.

use_cases.title: Add Dashboard Fullscreen
use_cases.description: Build a fullscreen mode for monitoring dashboards while preserving state and clear exit controls.

use_cases.title: Create Media Reviewers
use_cases.description: Add fullscreen photo or video viewers for teams that inspect project media.

use_cases.title: Design Presentation Mode
use_cases.description: Create keyboard-aware presentation screens with compatibility checks and cleanup guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Toggle
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a fullscreen toggle to my Angular component using screenfull. Explain required imports, state handling, and fallback behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Target One Element
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this Angular dashboard so only its container enters fullscreen. Include event listener cleanup and user-visible exit controls.

prompt_templates.title: Build Media Viewer
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a fullscreen image viewer for construction photos using screenfull and Angular signals. Include accessibility, mobile limits, and state reset behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Fullscreen Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my fullscreen implementation against the skill checklist. Identify browser compatibility gaps, event cleanup issues, and unsafe user interaction patterns.

output_examples.input: Add a fullscreen button to my dashboard.
output: A component-level implementation plan using screenfull.
State handling for fullscreen changes and exits.
Fallback behavior when the browser API is unavailable.

output_examples.output: A concise audit covering keyboard controls, exit handling, listener cleanup, and browser support.
A workflow that opens selected media in fullscreen, exits cleanly, and accounts for limited mobile browser support.

best_practices: Request fullscreen only after a clear user action.
Remove event listeners when the Angular component is destroyed.
anti_patterns: Do not force fullscreen on page load or without user intent.
Do not leave fullscreen change listeners registered after navigation.
Do not use fullscreen for sensitive confirmation or payment flows.

faq.question: What library does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses screenfull 6.x as a wrapper around the browser Fullscreen API.

faq.question: Does it support element-level fullscreen?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples show document fullscreen and fullscreen for a specific component container.

faq.question: Is mobile support guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Mobile browser support varies, and iOS Safari has important limits.

faq.question: Can it help with Angular standalone components?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples use Angular component patterns, signals, templates, and cleanup hooks.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. Any dependency installation requires user action.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends user-triggered fullscreen, exit controls, compatibility checks, and listener cleanup.
